# Favicon maker

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/favicon-maker/

Create a small square website icon from an image and download PNG or a PNG-encoded ICO file. Choose a size and crop or contain fit.

## How to use it

1. Choose your image or enter your own text.
2. Pick a layout, style or output size.
3. Create the result and download your shareable image.

## Example

Turn a simple logo into a 32-pixel icon, then export a larger 256-pixel version.

## Limits and checks

Fine text is difficult to read at icon sizes. PNG-encoded ICO files target modern browsers, not every legacy desktop application.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
